items.title: Louis Barbarin Interview, 1960-06-22
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Frank Holden, huh? That's Holden? Yeah. Frank Holden and Company, Al Hong.

ctx.x: No, I didn't call it. Frank Holden, huh? That's Holden? Yeah. Frank Holden and Company, Al Hong.
That's one of the good makes though, right? Yeah. It's in perfect shape, isn't it? Mm-hmm.
